algorithm.convergence_criteria: No convergence, residual, replication, numerical tolerance, cross-validation, or independent replay criterion is reported.
software: MATLAB is named for GM parameters and EViews for the AR prediction; no version, code, data file, or environment is supplied.

assumptions: The fifteen counts can be decomposed into a GM growth component and a smooth AR residual component, and the old regime can inform a baseline forecast.
Debris and impact proxies, AHP weights, min-max adjustment, vector length, and qualitative recovery direction adequately represent ocean-system status.
models.computational_cost: No runtime, memory, solver iteration, forecast replication, AHP elicitation cost, or evaluation refresh cost is reported.

details: The fitted regime, post-2000 recovery program, USA debris proxy, Hawaiian monk-seal impact proxy, normalization table, and compared years define local boundaries.
No demonstrated dynamical equilibrium is supplied; lower score and qualitative feedback are decision conventions.
The prediction begins from the fifteen 1985-1999 annual counts; evaluation uses adjusted yearly indicators.
No sampling, parameter, residual, structural-break, AHP, normalization, proxy, causal, forecast, or policy uncertainty is propagated.

constraints: Preserve physical page, year range, observed versus predicted status, units, adjustment basis, intervention regime, figure/table source, and downstream decision.
Do not convert fitted-period correlation, post-2000 coincidence, internal AHP scores, or qualitative feedback into externally validated causal effects.

equation_status.reason: The source expresses this unit through prose, figures, an AR-order statement, or a qualitative feedback diagram.

models.family: qualitative recovery feedback and policy translation

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: The sequence, formulas, figures, weights, vector, and feedback direction are inspectable, but decomposition, coefficients, uncertainty, causal attribution, proxy validity, robustness, and implementability are incomplete.

limitations: The feedback diagram contains no dynamic recovery equation, gain, delay, saturation, measurement rule, stability analysis, or controller design.
No end-to-end independent replay binds prediction, evaluation, feedback, and policy consequences.
missing_details: Frozen raw data, exact decomposition, AR coefficients, diagnostics, uncertainty, AHP elicitation, consistency, normalization table, causal design, population/food-web model, feedback dynamics, cost, authority, and monitoring thresholds are not supplied together.
objectives: Translate score decomposition into debris reduction, artificial recovery, and expedition-leader recommendations.
Keep observed counts, fitted trend, residual process, intervention break, debris index, impact proxy, score, and decision handoff distinct.

parameter_estimation.method: GM least squares, visually selected AR(2), stated AHP summation weights, min-max adjustment, and author judgment.

models.purpose: Translate score decomposition into debris reduction, artificial recovery, and expedition-leader recommendations.
strengths: The unit has a named local purpose and a visible downstream handoff.
The source repeatedly translates formulas or curve differences back into plain-language mechanism and action.
